block.description: Loads key/value pairs into Terraform — from .env files (dotenv_file) or directly from environment.

keys.description: Environment variable names to read from the process environment.

sensitive_envs.description: Keys whose values are returned in `sensitive_values` instead of `values`.

sensitive_values.description: Key/value pairs for keys listed in `sensitive_envs` (marked as sensitive).

values.description: Key/value pairs for all set keys not listed in `sensitive_envs`.

block.description: Reads the specified keys from the process environment and exposes their values to Terraform. Keys not present in the environment are silently omitted.

env_file.description: Name of the env file inside `env_path`. Defaults to `.env`.

env_path.description: Directory containing the env file. Defaults to the current working directory (`.`).

exclude_envs.description: These keys won't be included. Exclusive to `include_envs`.

include_empty.description: Is set to true, empty Keys will also be loaded (e.g. `FOO=`). Default is `false`

include_envs.description: Only these keys will be included. Exclusive to `exclude_envs`.

sensitive_envs.description: These keys will be set as `sensitive_values` instead of values.

block.description: Loads a `.env` file and exposes its key/value pairs to Terraform.
